name: pictelio-app
description: Pictelio SPA - Pixiv illustration browser built with SolidJS + Capacitor

scripts.appium:setup: APPIUM_HOME=$HOME/.appium appium driver install uiautomator2 && APPIUM_HOME=$HOME/.appium appium driver doctor uiautomator2
scripts.test:all: vp run test && vp run test:agent-browser
scripts.cap:init: vp exec cap init pictelio io.pictelio.app
scripts.build:android: vp run sync:android-version && vp run sync:credentials && vp run build && NODE_ENV=production pnpm --dir ../app-lynx run build && node ../app-lynx/scripts/sync-android-assets.mjs && vp run cap:sync && cd android && GRADLE_USER_HOME=$(pwd)/.gradle ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:e2e: vp run sync:android-version && vp run sync:credentials && vp build --mode e2e && vp run cap:sync && cd android && GRADLE_USER_HOME=$(pwd)/.gradle ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: vp run sync:android-version && vp run sync:credentials && vp run build && NODE_ENV=production pnpm --dir ../app-lynx run build && node ../app-lynx/scripts/sync-android-assets.mjs && vp run cap:sync && cd android && GRADLE_USER_HOME=$(pwd)/.gradle ./gradlew assembleFullRelease renameFullReleaseApk
scripts.build:android:release:all: vp run sync:android-version && vp run sync:credentials && vp run build && NODE_ENV=production pnpm --dir ../app-lynx run build && node ../app-lynx/scripts/sync-android-assets.mjs && vp run cap:sync && cd android && GRADLE_USER_HOME=$(pwd)/.gradle ./gradlew assembleFullRelease renameFullReleaseApk assembleWebviewRelease renameWebviewReleaseApk assembleLynxRelease renameLynxReleaseApk
